examples.text: Поро́й, в мину́ту нея́сного созна́ния, мелька́ло в уме́ его́, что он осуждён жить в како́м-то дли́нном, несконча́емом сне, по́лном стра́нных, беспло́дных трево́г, борьбы́ и страда́ний.
examples.translation: In moments when his mind was not clear, the thought flashed upon him that he was condemned to live in a long, unending dream, full of strange, fruitless agitations, struggles and sufferings.
examples.english: In moments when his mind was not clear, the thought flashed upon him that he was condemned to live in a long, unending dream, full of strange, fruitless agitations, struggles and sufferings.

examples.text: Я вставала ночью с постели и смотрела на нескончаемый людской поток, освещенный пламенем ярких костров, движущийся к Дому союзов.

an endless line

glosses: Too much or many to be exhausted; an extremely high number or amount of; immeasurable, innumerable.

examples.text: In 1903, [Albert Shhoenhut] announced his Humpty Dumpty circus, with over 20 figures and animals, each with six joints enabling them to be put into endless positions.

glosses: Not ending; having no end; eternal.

examples.text: At any rate I was very sure that I would not attempt to attain unending life.

examples.translation: 在他神智不清的時刻，一個念頭突然閃現：他彷彿被判處終生囚禁於漫長無盡的夢境之中，充斥著種種荒誕而徒勞的躁動、掙扎與苦痛。
